paragraphs: PASSUR Aerospace sells ARiVA, a suite of software and data services for the aviation industry. The ARiVA SaaS Platform combines aviation data into real-time intelligence and post-operational analytics. ARiVA Intelligence supplies predictive, real-time and historical data services, and ARiVA ADS-B tracks vehicles and aircraft.

The company says it serves commercial airlines, cargo carriers, business aviation operators, airports, air navigation service providers, and government and defense agencies. PASSUR describes the platform as consolidating global flight tracking, predictive analytics, and collaborative workflow.

quote.text: PASSUR consolidates global flight tracking, predictive analytics, and collaborative workflow into a single, always-on platform.
